source: Project Readiness Checklist.xlsx (Sparrow Capital / client DD checklist)

items.text: Discussion of organizational/administrative matters, including Project Company’s shareholders, shareholder structure, board members, key personnel, and organizational chart
Financial forecast summary, key metrics, and investment thesis
Discussion of commercial considerations, including revenue streams, operational expenses, margins, target market, demographics, marketing strategy, etc.
Technical considerations, including construction execution schedule and key contractors, subcontractors, suppliers, and service providers
Bios of all officers, directors, managers and shareholders (with more than 5% ownership)
Track record of the Sponsor/Parent Company in the operation and development of similar projects
Chart of corporate structure, including parent companies, affiliates, and subsidiaries, including ownership %
Diagram of the Project's board of directors, including their roles and responsibilities
CVs/Bios of executive officers and board members
Type of equity held in the Project Company (common or preferred shares, noncertified equity interest, etc.)
Main financial metrics of the Sponsor/Parent Company
List/chart of all of the Project Company's ultimate beneficial owners (UBO), including %
List/chart of all of the Sponsor/Parent Company's ultimate beneficial owners (UBO), including %
Minutes of all shareholder meetings related to the Project from the last three years
Summary of short-term and long-term strategic initiatives of the Sponsor/Parent Company
Discussion of any recent or planned acquisitions or divestitures

subcategories.name: Property Management Firm or O&M Contractor

items.text: List and bios of key personnel
Cost of capital/expected return of each component of the capital stack
Description of any agreements or arrangements providing any right to share in the equity, income, revenue, or cash flow of the Project Company
Future funding challenges, options, and opportunities
Equity investment in the Project Company so far and up to financial closing
Description of main terms and conditions of any loan agreements, indentures, and other debt instruments
Description of other financing instruments to which the Project Company is a party to
Description of other financing instruments to which the Project Company’s properties or assets are subject to
Description of other financing instruments under which the Project Company is guaranteeing or assuming the obligations of others
Description of supplier financing and usage
List and description of existing guarantees, including issuers, amount, and term
Documentation supporting assumptions made in the financial model
Project soft-cost investments so far and source of funding
Soft costs budget until financial closing
Financial ratios (i.e., coverage, liquidity, financial margins)
Last 3 years of audited Sponsor/Parent Company financial statements
Last 3 years of audited Project Company financial statements
Sample of monthly internal financial statements and management reporting packages

subcategories.name: Real Property Taxes and Other Governmental Impositions

items.text: Current bills showing all real properties taxes
Current bills showing all agricultural taxes
Current bills showing other ordinary and special assessments
Current bills showing water and sewer charges and other impositions
Current notices of real properties tax assessments
Current notices and assessments as to any special or other impositions
Notices or letters advising of pending reassessments or forthcoming special assessments

Pleadings, filings, notices and/or other correspondence pertaining to challenges, appeals or other proceedings concerning real properties tax matters, special assessments and other governmental impositions
Description of agreements with governmental or taxing authorities concerning the deferral or reduction of real properties taxes or other impositions, or payments in lieu of taxes
Information concerning any special taxing districts in which the properties is located
Revenue streams, cost drivers, and margins
Major competitors: market shares, strengths, and weaknesses
List of all applicable studies and designs performed
List of all permits, licenses, and governmental approvals maintained in connection with the operation of the project/properties
Site plan permit application and drawings
As-built plans and specifications for the properties (retrofit only)
Construction drawings, plans and specifications (all disciplines)
Architectural exterior and interior finishes, details, and schedules
Current major equipment list(s) and specifications
Project execution and major subcontractor plan
Construction cost estimate and draw schedule
Detailed designs, specifications and construction bid packages
Asbestos, lead paint and other physical reports
Raw material sources and availability (i.e., solar irradiance level, wind, fuel, etc.)
List of all studies pending to be performed (cost, date and time needed to be performed) and likely service providers
Temporary site infrastructure in place (fencing, signage, trailers)
Staging areas and material laydown plans developed
List of construction contracts, major subcontracts, and architectural services agreements
List of EPC firms considered, preliminary quotes, and status of negotiations
List of project management firms considered, preliminary quotes, and status of negotiations
Construction budget and Project cost breakdowns with contingency analysis
Management plans (i.e., project execution, procurement, quality, safety, logistics/transportation)
Expected quantitative impact/results of the Project
Production capacity, scalability, adaptability, and potential for future expansion
Technology selected for the Project and its suitability, including any licensors required
List of technology supply providers considered
Specifications and technical details of the equipment and infrastructure involved in the Project, including useful life, maintenance, and replacement requirements
Certifications or warranties associated with the equipment or infrastructure
Description of the Project's operations and maintenance procedures
Any relevant operational manuals or guidelines
Geotech report with soil tests, and borings

subcategories.name: Land Needed to Execute the Project

items.text: Description of current state of land negotiations
Estimated cost associated to land purchase/negotiations/investment
Engineering and other physical reports of the property in Seller’s possession or obtainable by Seller.
Current zoning and land use classifications and compliance of the properties with respect to zoning, subdivision and land use laws and regulations
List of applicable subdivision approvals, special exceptions, variances, and other governmental legislative and administrative actions concerning zoning, land use and subdivision matters
All violation notices, notices of pending rezoning or land use reclassifications, and all pleadings or filings pertaining to zoning, subdivision or land use actions or proceedings
Any opinions of counsel as to zoning, subdivision, or land use matters in the possession of seller
Any agreements, orders or decrees concerning impact fees, linkage fees, exactions, adequate public facilities charges or similar fees, or charges
Any agreements or proposed deeds with respect to any contemplated dedication or proffers to any governmental agency or private body of any portions of any of the properties

subcategories.name: Permits, Registrations, Consents, Licenses, Authorizations and Approvals

items.text: List of all permits, registrations, consents, licenses, authorizations or approvals by or from any governmental authority or agency held by the Project Company
Documentation regarding all permits, registrations, consents, licenses, authorizations, or approvals
Approved building permits or building permit applications
Sitework, soil erosion and sediment control, and grading permits
Any reports relating to the Project Company’s compliance with governmental regulations
Documentation showcasing compliance with labor, health, and safety regulations
Reports or certifications related to workplace safety and risk mitigation

Regulatory risks, potential changes in policies, and impact on Project’s viability
